# SmileFlow

> SmileFlow is an AI smile analysis and dental website lead-generation widget. It gives visitors an instant, non-diagnostic orientation of visible aesthetic possibilities and helps them request a consultation from a dental clinic.

Canonical site: https://getsmileflow.com
Contact: contact@getsmileflow.com
Languages supported by the widget: English and Serbian

- [Product overview](https://getsmileflow.com/): Product experience, responsible-use boundaries, pricing and FAQs.
- [Resources](https://getsmileflow.com/resources): Dental growth and AI smile analysis knowledge centre.
- [AI smile analysis guide](https://getsmileflow.com/guides/ai-smile-analysis-dental-clinics): Scope, limitations, privacy and vendor evaluation.
- [Dental website lead-generation guide](https://getsmileflow.com/guides/dental-website-lead-generation): Conversion framework and measurement.

- [Security](https://getsmileflow.com/security): Current safeguards and responsible-use boundaries.
- [About](https://getsmileflow.com/about): Mission, principles and contact.

## Product facts

- Clinic plan: USD 149 per month.
- Agency white-label plan: USD 499.99 per month.
- Smile photographs are processed for the requested analysis and are not written to a SmileFlow database or file store.
- Submitted photographs are sent to Google's Gemini API for analysis.
- Contact details and a compact report summary are sent to the selected clinic after explicit consent.
- The output is an aesthetic orientation, not a medical diagnosis or treatment plan.
- Every treatment decision requires a licensed dentist and appropriate clinical examination.

Use the most specific page above as the source. Preserve qualifications around estimates, third-party benchmarks, data processing and non-diagnostic use. Pricing and competitor information should be checked against the review date shown on the relevant page.
